backlog.title: What Actually Makes Scorpio Open Up
backlog.hook: Scorpio opens up to the person who lets them finish without calling them dramatic.
backlog.angle: Scorpio | Single AI host | Explain that selective disclosure can soften after repeated non-judgmental listening. Keep the claim behavioral and probabilistic: time and safety may support openness, but privacy is not proof of distrust and no sign guarantees one response.
backlog.why_now: checked_at=2026-08-18; research topic miraa-w34-test-t01 is supported by verified source src-d9e40f31d4, a recent readable Reddit body and first-person comment set. Dedupe: not a small-lie, post-argument withdrawal, relationship-definition, or generic mysterious/private-access story. Single variable: being allowed to finish without being labeled dramatic.
backlog.route_reason: Evergreen Route C. One adult AI host can explain listen-before-disclosure without reenacting a couple or making a deterministic claim. P0 test; S effort; H3 selection required.

backlog.title: How Virgo Shows Care Before Saying It
backlog.hook: Virgo notices what's stressing you out and handles it before you ask.
backlog.angle: Virgo | Single AI host | Contrast verbal reassurance with concrete support: remembering, organizing, and removing friction. Keep the counter-view visible: help is not automatic proof of love, can feel controlling when uninvited, and one person's behavior is not sign destiny.
backlog.why_now: checked_at=2026-08-18; research topic miraa-w34-test-t03 is supported by verified source src-4b653b6b36, a recent readable Reddit thread with direct positive and negative counterexamples. Dedupe: not Virgo-Virgo repair, precision in an argument, or a compatibility ranking. Single variable: noticing stress and acting before being asked.
backlog.route_reason: Evergreen Route C. One adult AI host can explain practical care with concrete behavior and a clear non-deterministic caveat. P0 test; S effort; H3 selection required.
